note: P4320 (Pro 28:10) — who misleads the upright falls into his own pit; the blameless inherit good.

dims.v: targeted integrity — the upright the wicked try to lead astray
the upright whom the wicked seek to mislead into an evil way — integrity targeted for corruption, yet preserved while the seducer falls into his own pit
welded to the blamelessness that inherits good

yashar (upright) — 'whoever misleads the UPRIGHT into an evil way will fall into his own pit'; the upright, though targeted by seducers, are safe — the trap recoils on the trapper. Integrity is protected (cf 26:27).
blamelessness — that inherits good while the seducer falls
the blamelessness that receives a goodly inheritance while the one who would corrupt the upright falls into his own pit — integrity rewarded, corruption self-destroyed
the upright it is joined with (266528)
welded to the upright who cannot be led astray

tamim (blameless/whole) — 'but the BLAMELESS will have a goodly inheritance'; blamelessness is rewarded with good, where the seducer of the upright is ruined. The whole-hearted inherit; the corrupt fall.
